segments.thag2.35:1.3: Tassa mayhaṃ ekakassa bherave bile viharato,
segments.thag2.35:1.4: Natthi bhayaṃ vā chambhitattaṃ vā lomahaṃso vā.
segments.thag2.35:2.1: “Dhammatā mamasā yassa me, ekakassa bherave bile;
segments.thag2.35:2.3: Viharato natthi bhayaṃ vā, chambhitattaṃ vā lomahaṃso vā”ti.

lines: Tattha devo ca vassati, devo ca gaḷagaḷāyatīti devo megho vassati ca,“gaḷagaḷā”ti ca karonto gajjatīti attho.

Ekako cāhaṃ bherave bile viharāmīti ahañca ekako asahāyo sappaṭibhayāyaṃ pabbataguhāyaṃ vasāmi, tassa mayhaṃ evaṃbhūtassa me sato natthi bhayaṃ vā chambhitattaṃ vā lomahaṃso vāti cittutrāsasaññitaṃ bhayaṃ vā taṃnimittakaṃ sarīrassa chambhitattaṃ vā lomahaṃsanamattaṃ vā natthi.
